review.notes: All 48 physical pages were scanned against the PDF text layer with a normalized word-n-gram droppage probe plus per-page targeted checks; fence structure is clean (no code fences); headings, figure captions and the two-column reference list (physical p.29-32) are complete. Footnote markers 1-5 survive inline while all five footnote bodies/URLs were dropped; each was transcribed from a 300-dpi render and is restored by insertion. Three OCR auto-corrections of the source's own misspellings ("resoluton" p.16, "aligment" p.45, missing letter in "Ruize Gao" p.31) were verified on renders; the print's own typos "feed-froward" (p.14), "use use" (p.38) and Table 10's "Larning Rate" (p.34) are correctly preserved by the OCR and left unchanged. Table cells were verified cell-by-cell only for Table 10; remaining tables matched the extracted values at probe level.
